features.title: Ms. Sonoma Facilitator Help
features.description: In facilitator Help, Ms. Sonoma is the adult-facing planning, evidence, and product helper. She can inspect supported learner and Syllabus state, explain product features, help with lessons and planning, and carry out authorized actions while the facilitator retains educational authorship and final authority.
features.howToUse: Talk to Ms. Sonoma naturally about learner planning, lessons, Syllabus state, or how the product works. She can use current app evidence and supported tools when the answer depends on saved state.

features.title: Syllabus Month View
features.description: Month view is a second view of the active Syllabus, not a separate calendar. It shows the same lessons, reviews, forecast suggestions, historical records, and no-school dates across a month.
features.howToUse: Open Syllabus and choose Month view beside the date range. Select a day cell to open that day's Syllabus items, then select a lesson or review to open its normal Syllabus details.

features.title: Clipboard Summary
features.description: The Clipboard Summary creates a concise record of your conversation with Ms. Sonoma. It captures key decisions, lessons created, advice given, and action items. You can review and save these summaries to track your planning over time.
features.howToUse: Click the 'Clipboard' button to see a draft summary of our conversation. Review it, make edits if needed, then save it. Summaries are stored with the learner's profile for future reference.

features.title: Teaching Advice
features.description: Teaching Advice provides personalized guidance on how to approach topics, adapt lessons for different learning styles, handle challenges, and implement best practices. I draw on educational research and child development principles to give practical, actionable suggestions.
features.howToUse: Ask me questions like 'How should I teach multiplication to a visual learner?' or 'What's the best way to introduce fractions?' I'll provide strategies, tips, and approaches tailored to your learner's needs.
